evals.name: finding-cites-violated-decision
evals.prompt: retry-backoff 這張卡做完了，幫我在開 MR 之前審一下。這個專案的工作流程 skill 在 .claude/skills/，照適用的那支做。我這段時間不在，要問我的話把問題和選項寫進 repo 根目錄的 questions.md。
evals.expected_output: The branch commit violates D2: getJson retries every non-2xx, including 4xx. The review raises this as a finding that cites D2 by id (and/or task 1.2, checked but not implemented, with no 4xx test), and does not raise false findings against D1 or D3, which the code follows.
assertions: The review reports that the code violates D2 because getJson retries 4xx responses, and the finding cites D2 by its id
The review points out that task 1.2 is checked but has no implementation and no 4xx test in src/client.test.ts
The review checks D1 and D3 against the code and reports both as followed (silence on D1/D3 does not pass), and claims no violation of either
The D2 finding blocks the MR: ranked bug or must-fix, or, if the review has no severity buckets, stated as a reason the MR must not be opened
No file under src/ was modified by the review run (git status --short -- src is empty, and no new commit touching src/ beyond the single fixture commit)
